title: cymopterus fendleri var. newberryi
intro: Cymopterus fendleri var. newberryi, commonly known as Newberry's desert parsley, is a variety of the Fendler's desert parsley plant, which belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). Newberry's desert parsley has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in aiding digestion and reducing inflammation, making it beneficial for individuals suffering from gastrointestinal issues and arthritis. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and carminative properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Newberry's desert parsley include coumarins, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
